title: Story 1.4: second-host (macOS) portability leg via clone-and-adopt handoff
summary: Full second-host proof on the macOS Orca server, delivered as a coordinator-authored handoff executed by a fresh agent on that host: secret-free host baseline (AC-4), fresh-host adoption through the kit's own inspect/plan/approve transaction as the appropriate real mutation (AC-12), offline and explicit live verification at correct scopes, the full local gate suites on macOS with the trapped-signal exit statuses observed and recorded as platform facts (the recorded signal-numbering concern), and persona-proof recomputation from the skill files the handoff branch provisions (the recorded persona-reproducibility concern). Evidence returns on a dedicated git evidence branch; no server-to-server Orca connections; no secrets in any pushed content.
